name: Font Size
what_it_does: Sets the point size of the selected text; the box opens a size list.
behavior: Opens Font Size (dropdown). Contents (18 controls): Color swatches, Font Size, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 36. [flyout of subfeature:font-size — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as the point-size box showing the current size (e.g. 12).
